entries.name: ASC X12 EDI Standard
entries.versionBasis: X12 Release Schedule page lists 008070 (ASC ballot December 2025, ballot confirmed January 2026, available March 2026) above 008060 and 008050; 009010 is in ballot.

licence.text: Proprietary; X12 work products require a paid licence (Licensed User, Licensed Developer, Internal or Commercial Use Licensing Partner)
licence.basis: Read the X12 Licensing Program page on x12.org, which lists the paid licence categories and annual fees for access to and use of X12 work products.

norn.overlap: purchase orders, invoices, advance ship notices, remittance, warehouse and transport EDI transactions

entries.notes: Schemas and code lists are delivered through the licensed Glass product. HIPAA-mandated implementation guides moved to 008060.

entries.name: GS1 Core Business Vocabulary ontology
entries.versionBasis: Ontology declares owl:versionInfo 2.0 and dct:modified 2021-09-30; CBV standard cover says ratified June 2022. Recorded date is ontology modification, not ratification; mismatch preserved.

licence.basis: GS1 repository disclaimer does not establish a redistribution grant; WebVoc Apache license is not inherited by CBV.

norn.overlap: External EPCIS business steps/dispositions/transaction types; preserve source values without equating them to Core statuses.

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.name: GS1 EPC Tag Data Standard prose
entries.versionBasis: GS1 TDS archive lists 2.3.0 published 31 October 2025; direct URL returned application/pdf.

licence.basis: No artifact-specific republication grant verified; do not extrapolate GS1 WebVoc Apache terms to TDS prose.

norn.overlap: EPC binary and URI encodings of product/asset identifiers; do not replace GTIN/GLN/SSCC base types.

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.name: GS1 EPC Tag Data Translation definitions and tables
entries.versionBasis: GS1 repository lists TDT 2.2.0 last modified 12 February 2025; actual SGTIN-96 JSON declares version 2.2 and date 2024-11-18T16:30:00Z.

licence.basis: Public JSON/XML and GS1 implementation IP policy do not establish an artifact-specific redistribution/derivative grant; rights review required before vendoring.

norn.overlap: SGTIN/SSCC/SGLN and other identifier encodings; translation grammar is source evidence, not an executable Norn mapping.

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.notes: TDS 2.3.0 and TDT 2.2.0 have distinct release identities; no invented TDT 2.3 payload or complete support for TDS 2.3 encodings. Redistribution: unverified.

entries.name: GS1 EPCIS REST OpenAPI interface
entries.versionBasis: Downloaded info.version states 2.0.1; exact patch release date unverified.

licence.basis: Explicit Apache2 declaration applies to this interface document; retain notices and review dependency closure separately before redistribution.

norn.overlap: Capture/query external visibility events through the ruled observe/perform boundary; no process runtime.

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.notes: Separate entry because its explicit license differs from unverified schema/ontology rights; not blanket licensing of all EPCIS artifacts. Redistribution: license-conditions.

licence.basis: Schema has no verified license notice; do not inherit Apache2 from the separate REST OpenAPI document.

norn.overlap: Inventory movement/aggregation/transformation observations; external event contract, not a new durable runtime.

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.name: GS1 Global Data Synchronisation Network (GDSN) Business Message Standards
entries.versionBasis: gs1.org GDSN page lists 'Maintenance release 3.1.37' as the newest release, with 'Approved Attributes for use with Release 3.1.37 (Nov 2026)'.

licence.text: GS1 copyright; unaltered reproduction for personal/internal use; no redistribution without written approval
licence.basis: Read the gs1.org Terms of use copyright notice (same site terms as the GDSN page); terms embedded in the GDSN XSD/BMS packages were not read.

norn.overlap: trade item master data, product attributes, catalogue item publication/subscription

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.notes: 3.1.x maintenance releases follow a regular cycle, so pin the release per integration. Network exchange runs through certified data pools. The XSD download terms were not checked.

entries.name: GS1 General Specifications
entries.versionBasis: GS1 General Specifications standard page on gs1.org reads 'This version: 26.0, Publication date: Jan 2026, Next version planned for Jan 2027'.

licence.text: GS1 copyright; reproduce unaltered for personal/non-commercial or internal use only; no redistribution or commercialisation without written approval
licence.basis: Read the Copyright Notice in the gs1.org Terms of use page (content may be reproduced only in unaltered form for personal, non-commercial or internal use; re-transmission, distribution or commercialisation needs prior written approval); the PDF's own front-matter disclaimer was not read.

norn.overlap: GTIN/GLN/SSCC identification keys, application identifiers, barcode allocation rules

entries.notes: gs1.org blocks plain fetchers (403) and needed a browser user agent. We can use the key structures and check-digit rules and map to them; issuing real keys needs a GS1 Company Prefix (allocation policy not re-read today).

entries.name: UN/CEFACT Buy-Ship-Pay Web Vocabulary D23B
entries.versionBasis: Official home/about pages identify BSP D23B; full JSON-LD fetched anonymously (8,764,615 bytes). Directory label alone does not supply a precise release date.

licence.basis: Artifact site's terms explicitly withhold redistribution and derivative rights; no specific grant for these D23B bytes verified. A different UN/LOCODE site's CC BY footer is not transferred here.

norn.overlap: Modular commerce alignment vocabulary per Astra #2986; trade parties/products/agreements/delivery/payment remain source-namespaced and do not become Core authority.

priority.reason: Trade documents and item identity are SAP SD/MM table stakes.

entries.notes: New GitLab project points to vocab.unece.org (created 2026-04-24); its raw LICENSE returned 403. New deployment is not silently substituted for this identified old D23B artifact. Redistribution: prohibited-without-permission.
